description: This file contains integration tests for the delete functionality of articles in the Conduit project. It verifies that articles, including those with tags and comments, can be successfully deleted from the database.

classes.name: DeleteTests
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying the delete functionality of articles, including cases with tags and comments.

methods.description: Tests successful deletion of an article.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Comments
methods.description: Tests deletion of an article that has comments attached.
